roles.query_template: SELECT department, SUM(CASE WHEN employee_type = N'ประจำ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS regular_count, SUM(CASE WHEN employee_type = N'สัญญา' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contract_count, COUNT(*) AS employee_count, CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN employee_type = N'สัญญา' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS decimal(10,2)) AS contract_pct FROM employees WHERE status = N'ปฏิบัติงาน' GROUP BY department HAVING 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN employee_type = N'สัญญา' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) > 50 ORDER BY department

WITH category AS (SELECT skill_category, COUNT(*) AS total_skills, SUM(CASE WHEN proficiency_level = N'เชี่ยวชาญ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expert_count FROM skills GROUP BY skill_category) SELECT skill_category, total_skills, expert_count FROM category UNION ALL SELECT N'รวมทั้งหมด' AS skill_category, SUM(total_skills) AS total_skills, SUM(expert_count) AS expert_count FROM category ORDER BY skill_category

WITH ranked AS (SELECT project_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY project_value DESC) AS rn FROM projects) SELECT SUM(project_value) AS total_project_value, SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 2 THEN project_value ELSE 0 END) AS top_two_project_value FROM ranked
SELECT COUNT(*) AS training_record_count, SUM(CASE WHEN certificate_obtained = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS obtained_true_count FROM training_records
SELECT COUNT(*) AS certification_record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT employee_id) AS certified_employee_count FROM certifications

roles.query_template: WITH active_headcount AS (SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS active_employee_count FROM employees WHERE status = N'ปฏิบัติงาน' GROUP BY department), project_totals AS (SELECT e.department, SUM(p.project_value) AS project_value FROM projects p JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = p.employee_id GROUP BY e.department) SELECT h.department, h.active_employee_count, p.project_value FROM active_headcount h JOIN project_totals p ON p.department = h.department ORDER BY h.department
